messages:
Zoe SRE: getting a spike of PD pages from inference-runtime-error, looks like dedupe isn't grouping correctly right now
incident-bot: ALERT: inference-runtime-error firing on 3 hosts (threshold breach) — auto-created PD incident INC-8921
Zoe SRE: @Marco can you take a look? This is noisy, multiple duplicate alerts per host
Marco (eng-sre): on it, pulling logs. if we need live mitigation we should add a temporary rate cap on the alert bridge
Priya (prod-infra): FYI the recent ruleset change to grouping by host:{{instance}} landed last night — that might be the cause
Daniel (svc-owner): customer-impact? any user-facing errors seen in SLOs/alerts?
Zoe SRE: quick check: 5xx from model-proxy is up ~25% for a minute, but most requests succeed after retry. Impact: small uptick in errors, not widespread degradations so far
Marco (eng-sre): logs show a faulty lib causing repeated stack traces, same stack per host. deduper is matching on fingerprint but the fingerprint changed because we altered the stack frame sanitizer. rolling back that sanitizer could re-enable better grouping
Alice (devex): can we avoid PD fatigue? propose 2-step: 1) add a temp rate-limit on PD (1/min) for this alert key, 2) add an aux alert that summarizes per-cluster error-rate (one page for cluster)
PD Bot: PagerDuty: Incident INC-8921 acknowledged by Zoe SRE
Zoe SRE: applying temporary PD-rate-limit now, will also update the alert rule to emit a summary metric. command: /pd throttle INC-8921 60s
Marco (eng-sre): attempting quick revert of sanitizer in canary host to test dedupe. if grouping improves, we'll rollback globally
Priya (prod-infra): creating a short-lived dashboard panel to watch dedupe keys and aggregated error-rate. Query used (Prometheus):

```
sum by(cluster) (increase(model_proxy_request_errors_total[1m]))
```

Priya (prod-infra): will add panel to ops->inference/runtime dashboard and share link
Daniel (svc-owner): thanks. please let me know if we should trigger a customer comms draft — right now seems limited but worrying
Marco (eng-sre): can confirm canary shows grouping restored after revert. dedupe now collapses 12->1 for that host
Zoe SRE: nice, Marco — what's the rollback plan?
Marco (eng-sre): simple: revert commit 9f4a2 in model-proxy on remaining hosts, one pool at a time. patch available. I'll coordinate with Priya for ramping
Priya (prod-infra): scheduling rollout: canary -> pool-a -> pool-b with 2m pause checks. I'll add automated health checks: latency and error-rate thresholds
Zoe SRE: PD rate-limit still in place, if revert looks good we'll remove it after pools are patched. leaving handoff to Marco for rollout and Priya for automation
Marco (eng-sre): taking oncall handoff. will post updates here. next update in 10m
Zoe SRE: thanks — handing off. Zoe SRE signing out from active mitigation. :white_check_mark:
Marco (eng-sre): update 2313457100: pool-a rolled, errors down to baseline, dedupe grouping stable. removing PD throttle soon
PD Bot: PagerDuty: Throttle removed for INC-8921 by Marco (eng-sre)
Zoe SRE: closing loop: action items — 1) revert sanitizer permanently or patch to preserve stable fingerprints, 2) add cluster-level aggregate alert to avoid per-host pages, 3) create dashboard panel (Priya) and runbook note (Alice). I'll file cards after this thread
Alice (devex): I'll add the runbook snippet and example PD suppression command to dev-docs
Marco (eng-sre): last message for thread: monitoring looks stable. if anything else crops up reopen INC-8921 or start a new thread
